ways.label: Waikanae Link Track
evidence: The track is accessed from multiple entry points in Waikanae - at Manly Street, Takahe Drive, Otaihanga Road end, or the Otaihanga Boat Club

doubts: The page never says where the track starts or ends; it only lists entry points (Manly Street, Takahe Drive, Otaihanga Road end, Otaihanga Boat Club). Manly Street, listed first, is taken as the start; the end is left null though the Otaihanga Boat Club (listed last, with parking on Makora Road) may be the other end. Shape one_way comes only from DOC's '20 min one way'. The boat club ref F7 rests on the text placing its parking on Makora Road; Takahe Drive and Otaihanga Road end have no matching feature.
